contract.grounded: Product name, description and feature facts carry evidence IDs bound to the fetched final URL, content SHA-256 and fetch time.
contract.partial: Sparse fetched evidence is returned as partial and requiresReview=true rather than filled with guesses.
contract.fallback: Expected fetch failures degrade only when explicit user fallback is present; confidence=0, requiresReview=true and every item is labeled user_input.
contract.claim_policy: Creative generation may use only facts linked to evidence IDs; unsupported claims must not be invented.

residual_risks: This deterministic evidence layer does not call a model; real cloud model orchestration begins in CSV2-04.
User fallback remains unverified until reviewed and must not be promoted to fetched evidence.
